profiles: same serving artifact, zero and one trained candidate; fresh isolated root each task, native child continuation

gate.original_dev: candidate >=7/8 and no task/fidelity regression vs simultaneous zero; old scores and old gain rule preserved historically, not reused as new ceiling trap
gate.diagnostic: candidate all3 cases both repeats met, zero illegal calls/false-work claims; compare zero separately
gate.original_read: same fixed21+3 each arm; no regression
gate.confirmation: only after dev+diagnostic+read gates, same original4 each repeat fullpass and no zero regression; no repair after confirmation

source_isolation: all API development kept out of training; DATA/WEB confirmation unchanged; no private holdout read
selection: one candidate zero-init lr1e-4, no tuning after confirmation
monetary_cost: unknown until real tariffs; include failures/strong/training amortization
